name: Byakuya Kuchiki
note: No build guide available on hideoutgacha.com at time of authoring. Tier/role/damage type sourced from the tier list.

skills.description:
Byakuya slashes the enemy in front with Senbonzakura up to 4 times, dealing damage equal to 194%~???% of ATK. ~~Dancing Petals~~ Bankai State 
  Byakuya wields the blade formed by sakura petals and attacks the enemy up to 5 times, dealing damage equal to 410%~???% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure on hit. ~~Piercing Blade~~ In Bankai state, press and hold basic attack when Spiritual Pressure is above 50% 
 Byakuya controls the Sakura Blade to release a continuous shockwave on the enemy, consuming Spiritual Pressure over time and dealing damage equal to 594%~???% of ATK. When the attack ends, deals extra damage equal to 360%~???% of ATK. 
 While active, pauses all of Byakuya's status timers. Removes Bankai when the attack ends.
skills.name: Zanjutsu

skills.description:
Senbonzakura's blade scatters into countless tiny sharp pieces that strike the enemy after 3.5 seconds, dealing damage equal to 287%~???% of ATK. During this time, you can switch on-field characters, and Byakuya will remain on the field until the attack completes. 
 While Byakuya's Battlefield Skill is active, releasing this technique grants 4 Battlefield Skill Energy. ~~Absolute Despair~~ Bankai State 
 Byakuya controls a massive wave of sakura petals to attack up to 3 times, dealing damage equal to 969% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure on hit.
skills.name: Scatter, Senbonzakura

skills.description: Byakuya fully splits the blade into tiny blades and strikes multiple times faster than Shikai, dealing damage equal to 264~???% of ATK. He then enters the Bankai state, enhancing both of his basic attacks and techniques. The Bankai state lasts 15s and remains active even if Byakuya is switched out.
skills.name: Bankai - Senbonsakura Kageyoshi

skills.description: After countering an attack, Byakuya instantly releases Bakudo to restrain an enemy and follows up with Hado Number 33: Sokatsui, dealing damage equal to ???% of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
~~White Byakuya's Battlefield Skill is active, all teammates' Slash DMG increases by 30%.~~ 
 
 Byakuya's Battlefield Skill button will be activated for 2s after any character releases a special attack, technique, or counterattack, but not at any other time. 
 Byakuya  transforms fluttering petals into blades and pierces enemies, pinning them to the ground and dealing DMG equal to 159.37% of ATK. 
 
 If Byakuya's Battlefield Skill Energy drops to zero after releasing this skill, tap the Battlefield Skill button again to trigger a follow-up attack with the same effect as the 4th strike of basic attack Dancing Petals.
skills.name: Thousand Blade Funeral

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Byakuya gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
